fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) stock surged 20%, with Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang's return announcement acting as positive signal.
fields.summary_ko.1: Micron's high-bandwidth memory (HBM) is critical component for Nvidia AI chips, with CEO return easing concerns about AI market slowdown.
fields.summary_ko.2: CEO Sanjay Mehrotra has 75% of 2027 supply pre-booked, with Citi analyst expecting only modest memory demand reduction even if Nvidia finances halt.
